# testing_oas_write_only_nested (Resource)

OASWriteOnlyNested Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_write_only_nested" "my_oaswriteonlynested" {
  id   = "...my_id..."
  name = "...my_name..."
  ssh_credential = {
    keys = {
      passphrase  = "...my_passphrase..."
      private_key = "...my_private_key..."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Requires replacement if changed.
- `ssh_credential` (Attributes) SSH credentials with writeOnly nested properties. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_credential))

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Resource status

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_credential"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_credential`

Optional:

- `keys` (Attributes) SSH key information - all properties are writeOnly. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_credential--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_credential--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_credential.keys`

Optional:

- `passphrase` (String) Passphrase for the private key. Requires replacement if changed.
- `private_key` (String) Private SSH key. Requires replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `key_type` (String) Type of SSH key
